_note: PROTOTYPE thresholds. MQ-series sensors are uncalibrated indicators, NOT certified gas measurements. A real deployment needs calibrated, certified multi-gas detectors. Edit these numbers freely; the backend reloads them on restart.

methane_ppm.note: 5000 ppm = 10% of methane's lower explosive limit (5% by volume)

combustible_ppm.note: MQ-2 indicator, same scale as methane

air_quality_index.note: MQ-135 relative index, 0-500, no official unit

h2s_ppm.note: NIOSH 10-minute ceiling 10 ppm; OSHA ceiling 20 ppm

oxygen_pct.note: OSHA: below 19.5% is oxygen-deficient, above 23.5% is oxygen-enriched

tilt_deg.note: MPU6050 on the manhole cover: tilt above this means the cover is open

combined.note: 3 or more simultaneous warnings escalate to CRITICAL
